Amelia: Heads up — we need final alignment on private deployment packaging launch prerequisites. Focus: VPC + on-prem install, upgrade paths, customer-managed networking. I sketched a short checklist below, please call out blockers by EOD.
Raj: Quick proposal for MVP packaging: single helm chart for k8s + tarball installer for airgap/legacy infra. Default install path = helm + values file, airgap = tarball + local registry. Defer platform-specific HSM support from MVP.
Maya: +1 on packaging approach, but flagged: a few customers are explicit about KMS/HSM for compliance. If we defer KMS entirely we risk blocking a named customer.
Ben: Implementation constraints: we can support KMS for MVP if we limit scope to AWS KMS and GCP KMS (no vendor HSM, no PKCS11). Upgrade strategy: prefer rolling in-place upgrades with versioned DB migrations and pre/post hooks. Need to expose migration hooks in the chart.
Sofia: Security asks: key rotation docs, bring-your-own-CA for VPC connectors, and telemetry off-by-default for airgapped installs. Also require documented CSPs for network flows in VPC mode.
Raj: Installer sketch (WIP):
```
# airgap install
./rdi-install.sh --mode airgap --image-dir ./images --values ./private-values.yaml
# k8s live
helm upgrade --install rdi ./charts/private -f ./values.yaml
```
Include: `private.deploy.enabled=true`, `kms.provider: aws|gcp`, `agent.autoscale=false` for on-prem defaults.
Maya: Test matrix proposal: minor->minor upgrades, minor->major, airgap->online migration, and rollback validation. Need a staging harness to run upgrade/e2e against realistic customer manifests.
Amelia: Decision points to finalize:
1) KMS MVP scope = AWS + GCP only? (Y/N)
2) Rolling upgrade (default) vs replace-install (opt-in)?
3) Snapshot retention / rollback window — 24h vs 7d?
Ben: We can commit to AWS+GCP KMS for launch if Solutions runs simple validation scripts. Rolling in-place upgrades are feasible; fallback plan = snapshot -> restore. Retention: 7 days is reasonable for most customers; 24h rollback is also doable but riskier.
Amelia: Quick votes: @Raj KMS AWS/GCP only? @Ben rollback window? Please reply with thumbs.
Raj: :thumbsup: AWS/GCP only for MVP.
Ben: :thumbsup: Rolling upgrades default; snapshot retention 7d, but document 24h quick-rollback play.
Maya: I'll surface the top 3 KMS-gated customers and confirm which can accept AWS/GCP only. Will push by EOD.
Amelia: Action items: Raj - publish installer CLI + chart values reference by Wed; Ben - upgrade playbook + rollback steps by Fri; Maya - customer list for KMS gating by EOD. I'll sync with Eng Leads tomorrow and escalate any hard blockers. Marking these as launch-blockers until QA matrix is green.
deploy-bot: private-package pipeline queued — requires `private-release` tag on the release branch to proceed.
